name: Nomad Bridge
fix_description: In process, add a check that messages[_messageHash] != bytes32(0) before calling acceptableRoot. The default mapping value 0x00 was accidentally marked as a trusted root during initialize, allowing unproven messages to be processed. The fix ensures only messages that have been explicitly proven can be processed.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is essentially a single-call replay/copy-paste of an already valid bridge message with only the recipient address changed, requiring no flash loans, pricing logic, or complex multi-contract sequencing. Although the underlying bridge bug is subtle, writing this PoC from the provided transaction data is straightforward and well within 30 minutes for a competent auditor.
